ValidationRule.description: Compliance results can not be changed to blank unless some fields under Compliance are available
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND ( RecordType_DeveloperName__c='Compliance_Query', NOT(ISNEW()), TEXT(Type)='Compliance', ISCHANGED(Compliance_Results__c), OR( ISBLANK(TEXT(Origin_of_Alert__c)), ISBLANK(TEXT(Speculated_FCC_Risk_Type__c)) )
)
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Origin of Alert, Speculated FCC Risk Type and Compliance Results are required to be filled by Compliance team post validating.
